limits: Supports the tested upright L geometry and one adjustable-shelf bay. Arbitrary skewed/ambiguous panel intersections and custom hinge patterns are not inferred.
Through-back supports follow a positively recognized or saved existing pattern; rows are not invented in other backs.
Stored row offsets stay anchored to their source-edge ends; pitch and above/below hole counts use current defaults.
All drilling circles are validated against actual receiving faces. Unsupported circles or source geometry are rejected before mutation.
No hardware insertion, folded-door hinge model or opening animation is introduced.

historicalChecks.note: Two old test harnesses contain hard-coded production-reference assumptions and stopped before their synthetic fixture sections. They are not included in the passing count. Self-contained shelf arrangement/removal, joinery datum, orphan cleanup and current actual-corner tests provide the relevant regression coverage.
